paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na nu uh makna lai, ka makna, koi a om ahia? Ahihkeileh, ka leibatnate akua pen kiang ah ahia ka hon zuaktak? Ngai un, na thulimlouhnate uh ziak a na nu uh mak a om ahi.
heading: TOUPA'N Amah Muangte Apanpih
english: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.

paite: "Bangziak in ahia ka hong pai a mi himhim a-om louh uh? Bangziak in ahia ka sap a hon dawng ding a-om louh uh? Ka khut hotdam theih louh ding in tomsak in a-om himhim a hia? Ahihkeileh, humbit ding in thilhihtheihna ka nei kei a hia? Ngai un, ka salhna in tuipi ka kangsak a, luipite gamkeu in ka bawl hi; tui himhim a-om louh ziak in angasate a-uih ua, dangtak in asi uh.
english: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.

paite: "Van mial in ka thuam a, akhuhna ding in sai-ip puan ka bawl zel," chi in.
english: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”

paite: Mi gimtak thu a ka tawldamsak siamna ding in sinsakte lei Toupa PATHIAN in ahon pia; ama'n zingsang teng a phawng in, sinsakte atheih bang ua thei ding in ka bil aphawng zel.
heading: TOUPA Sikha Thumanna
english: The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in ka bil ahon vangsak a, kei zaw ka hel kei, ka lehngat sam kei hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.

paite: Ka nungzang sat mite ka doh a, ka biang mul bot mite ka doh hi; zahlakna ah leh chilsiatna ah ka mai ka sel kei.
english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in ahon panpih ding a; huaiziak in ka zum kei a; huaiziak in meisah suang bang in ka nga zel a, ka zahlak kei ding chih ka thei.
english: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.

paite: Siam hon tangsakpa anai hi; kua'n ahia hon dou ding? Dingkhawm ni ung; hon dou kua ahia? Hon naih mah hen aw.
english: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.

paite: Ngai in, Toupa PATHIAN in hon panpih ding; kua'n ahia siam louh hon tangsak ding? Ngai in, huaite puansilh bang in alui ding ua, kausi in anese ding.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.

paite: Na lak ua, TOUPA kihta a, asikha thu mang, kua ahia? Mial nuai a khosa, vakna himhim nei lou in TOUPA min muang henla, a Pathian ah kinga hen.
english: Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in Yahweh’s name, and rely on his God.

paite: Mei toh a, mei-ekte a ki-umte aw, ngai un; na meikuang uah leh na mei-ek halte uh lak ah vak un. Hiai ka khut a kipan a na muh ding uh ahi hi; lungkhamtak a na lupna ding uh.
english: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.
